title: Richest Customer Wealth
summary: Given an m x n grid of account balances, determine the maximum total balance a single customer possesses across all their accounts.
statement: Given an m x n grid of account balances, determine the maximum total balance a single customer possesses across all their accounts.
constraints: At least one customer and one account; balances are nonnegative.
Customer wealth is their row sum. Return the maximum row sum.
reference_solution:
def richest_customer_wealth(accounts):
 return max(sum(customer) for customer in accounts)
hints: Each customer is independent, so first aggregate rows and then compare totals.
Compute every row sum and retain the largest.
Map sum across accounts and return max.
The definition of wealth is exactly a row sum, and max selects the richest among all customers.
editorial: The definition of wealth is exactly a row sum, and max selects the richest among all customers.

tests.explanation: Both customers total six, so the greatest wealth is six.
The second customer totals ten, the maximum.
